description: Undoes a Deal Desk purchase recorded by mistake (before it is listed or sold): the card comes out of the user's SlabLineage collection and the purchase no longer counts on the Deal Desk scoreboard. Before calling, ask the user "Undo the purchase of <card> for $<price>? It comes out of your collection and the scoreboard." and pass confirm true after they say yes. Pass an idempotencyKey. Undoing a purchase that is already undone answers repeated true and changes nothing. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

confirm.description: True once the user said yes to undoing this purchase; never set it before that.

dealId.description: The dealId of the purchase (from record_purchase).

idempotencyKey.description: A unique key for this record (any short text you make up once); a retry with the same key never records twice.

name: undo_purchase
title: Undo a purchase
